versions.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

- Added RocketReach brand logo to documentation.

Full rewrite to new standard: added tool reference tables, 3-step GIF table, architecture diagram, code examples, error handling, and troubleshooting.

Initial release of rocketreach-contact-intel skill:

- Search people and companies, inspect contact intelligence, and review company signals in RocketReach via ClawLink.
- Supports RocketReach connection without needing separate API credentials.
- Provides detailed quick start and setup instructions for ClawLink integration.
- Enables dynamic discovery and execution of RocketReach tools based on user’s connected account.
- Includes strict guidelines for usage, confirmation, and credential handling.
